camel_example: aliyun ndr ListIncidents --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --SortBy last_time --AIAnalysisResult.1 real_attack --SortOrder desc --Page 1 --Lang zh --AttackerIp '192.0.2.10' --IncidentName '异常访问关联事件' --EntityKey '192.0.2.10' --ToTime 1788393600000 --EntityUuid 'f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291' --HandleStatus.1 unhandled --FromTime 1788307200000 --IncidentUuid 'f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291' --ThreatLevel.1 2 --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Performs a paging query of security events. You can filter the results by event name, ID, threat level, handling status, AI analysis result, and associated entity
description_zh: 分页查询安全事件，可按事件名称、ID、威胁等级、处理状态、AI 分析结果及关联实体筛选
kebab_example: aliyun ndr list-incidents --from-time 1788307200000 --to-time 1788393600000 --page 1 --page-size 10 --incident-name '异常访问关联事件' --incident-uuid f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291 --threat-level 2 --handle-status unhandled --ai-analysis-result real_attack --attacker-ip 192.0.2.10 --entity-uuid f4b34c92-6f18-4b67-b5ea-68ff18ad3291 --entity-key 192.0.2.10 --lang zh --sort-by last_time --sort-order desc --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIncidents

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter filters events by their most recent occurrence time. If IncidentUuid is not specified, this parameter must be provided together with ToTime. If IncidentUuid is specified, both parameters can be omitted
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳，按事件最近发生时间筛选。未指定 IncidentUuid 时必须与 ToTime 同时提供；指定 IncidentUuid 时可同时省略
parameters.name: from_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter must be provided together with FromTime or omitted together. You cannot provide only one of the time parameters
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。必须与 FromTime 同时提供或同时省略，不能只传一个时间
parameters.name: to_time

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the security event. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 安全事件名称，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: incident_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security event. You can obtain the ID from ListIncidents
parameters.help_zh: 安全事件 ID，可从 ListIncidents 获取
parameters.name: incident_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The list of threat levels for the events. Valid values:
0: Information.
1: Low.
2: Medium.
3: High.
4: Critical
parameters.help_zh: 事件威胁等级列表。0 表示信息，1 表示低危，2 表示中危，3 表示高危，4 表示严重
parameters.name: threat_level

parameters.help_en: The list of handling status identifiers for the security events
parameters.help_zh: 安全事件的处理状态标识列表
parameters.name: handle_status

parameters.help_en:
The list of AI analysis results. Valid values:
real_attack: Real attack.
attempt_attack: Attack attempt
parameters.help_zh: AI 分析结果列表。real_attack 表示真实攻击，attempt_attack 表示攻击尝试
parameters.name: ai_analysis_result

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for the attacker IP address. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 攻击者 IP 地址筛选条件，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: attacker_ip

parameters.help_en: The ID of the entity. You can obtain the ID from ListEntities. This parameter queries events associated with the entity. If both EntityUuid and EntityKey are provided, EntityUuid takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 实体 ID，可从 ListEntities 获取。查询与该实体关联的事件；与 EntityKey 同时提供时，以 EntityUuid 为准
parameters.name: entity_uuid

parameters.help_en: The business value of the entity, such as an IP address, domain name, or cloud instance ID. Exact match is used. This parameter takes effect only when EntityUuid is not provided
parameters.help_zh: 实体的业务值，例如 IP 地址、域名或云实例 ID，采用精确匹配。仅在未提供 EntityUuid 时生效
parameters.name: entity_key

parameters.help_en:
The language of the returned content. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.
Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 返回内容的语言。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文，默认中文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The field used for sorting. Valid values:
threat_level: Threat level.
first_time: First occurrence time.
last_time: Most recent occurrence time.
If this parameter is not specified, the results are sorted in descending order of threat level and then in descending order of most recent occurrence time
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。threat_level 表示威胁等级，first_time 表示首次发生时点，last_time 表示最近发生时点。不传时先按威胁等级降序，再按最近发生时点降序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
asc: Ascending order.
desc: Descending order.
Default value: desc when SortBy is specified
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向。asc 表示升序，desc 表示降序。指定 SortBy 时默认为 desc
parameters.name: sort_order

Data.description_en: The query results or the data returned by the operation
Data.description_zh: 查询结果或操作返回数据

List.description_en: The list of results on the current page

AIAnalysisResult.description_en:
The AI analysis result. Valid values:
real_attack: Real attack.
attempt_attack: Attack attempt
AIAnalysisResult.description_zh: AI 分析结果。real_attack 表示真实攻击，attempt_attack 表示攻击尝试

ExternalIpEntityCount.description_en: The number of external IP entities associated with the event
ExternalIpEntityCount.description_zh: 事件关联的外部 IP 实体数量

FirstTime.description_en: The time when the event first occurred. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
FirstTime.description_zh: 事件首次发生时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

HandleStatus.description_en: The handling status identifier of the security event
HandleStatus.description_zh: 安全事件的处理状态标识

IncidentName.description_en: The name of the security event

IncidentUuid.description_en: The ID of the security event. You can obtain the ID from ListIncidents
IncidentUuid.description_zh: 安全事件 ID，可从 ListIncidents 获取

LastTime.description_en: The most recent time when the event occurred. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
LastTime.description_zh: 事件最近发生时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

RelateAlertCount.description_en: The number of associated raw alerts

ThreatLevel.description_en:
The threat level of the event. Valid values:
0: Information.
1: Low.
2: Medium.
3: High.
4: Critical
ThreatLevel.description_zh: 事件威胁等级。0 表示信息，1 表示低危，2 表示中危，3 表示高危，4 表示严重

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number. Pages start from 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
PageSize.description_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that meet the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的记录总数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails

Message.description_en: The description of the request result or the cause of the failure
Message.description_zh: 请求结果说明或失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查请求问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
